I am not the type of person to write reviews. So when I tell you me doing this is a big deal, you better keep reading. I had horrible dry patches on my cheeks and nose and very uneven tone. Pregnancy ruined my skin. I went into Ulta looking for something to put under my normal moisturizer and was given this. After about 2 weeks of use, I can't explain it but my skin just looks….different. It's moisturized, smooth, my complexion is better. I'm glowing. I look how I did in my 20s. This Marula Oil is AMAZING! I've always had good skin and I've been able to get away with grocery store moisturizer and not much else in term of skin care. All of a sudden my skin became very dry and dull when I hit 50. I went in search of products that are better suited to mature skin and I found Drunk Elephant! I use the Marula Oil religiously every night right before bed. My skin is so soft and glowing! My husband even noticed! I also use a tiny drop of the Marula Oil mixed with a drop of the B-Goldi drops and a drop of the Rosi Drops on my cheeks to give me a little glow in the morning. It gives me enough of a glow that I often don't need any other makeup than mascara and lip gloss for daytime. I also use the oil on my cuticle nightly. I've always struggled with cracking and bleeding cuticles. That has not been a problem since I started using Marula Oil on my nails! Yes, this product expensive, but it's long lasting and effective…..worth every penny. I also tried the Ordinary brand Marula oil because it is cheaper. The Ordinary Brand is ok, but I went back to Drunk Elephant brand after a week. The Drunk Elephant Brand Marula Oil is just superior. Love it!

avis.titre: wanted to love, but a big let down
avis.texte: I was excited to try this oil based on the reviews. I had high expectations at the price point and was comparing it to my $8 squalane oil that I had been using and loving. So when I got the bottle, saw how small it was in person , that was the first letdown. but I figured, hey, this is probably going to be super awesome and amazing for such a high price and a small amount it's gotta be amazing... buuutttt it wasn't. I didn't like the consistency first off. I felt like I was putting olive oil on my face. I also didn't feel like it was moisturizing. Yes it's oil, but it just sat on my skin. I didn't feel or see it absorb in the same time my regular oil would absorb. I really can't pinpoint what the deal breaker was, it was just everything! the consistency, the amount, the price, the quality.. bottom line: an over-hyped, over priced, social media trend. this isn't the high quality product they want you to think it is. they slap a high price tag and make you think it's worth paying for BECAUSE it's a high cost. but really it's not. There are other clean oils that work better for a FRACTION of the cost (literally $8) that I trust way more and prefer to this DE one. truly think about why you're buying certain products and don't be afraid to return it! buy what works for you, and if you actually like this product and can afford to replace it every 2-3 weeks, good for you... but IMO this is NOT quality, this IS overpriced, and there ARE far better options.
I put the oil on my face and neck while skin is still wet from shower! I might occasionally add a moisturizer but it's rare. DE marula is all I need! Love it!

avis.titre: My Honest Review? A Total Waste of Money!
avis.texte: As a middle-aged male who was recommended to try some skincare products to improve my appearance, I recently bought about $200 worth of products from Drunk Elephant. After weeks of using them, long story short none of them did anything to help my skin in any noticeable way. I'm not someone who was already using a ton of expensive products, all I regularly do is wash my face with soap and water. So it's not like these products had a high threshold to satisfy me. All they needed to do was ANYTHING to improve my skin, but instead they did nothing noticeable and it was a complete waste of $200. Will they improve your skin? I have no idea. But they didn't do anything for mine which is why I feel like most of the beauty industry is a load of crock and people shouldn't waste their money.

I purchased this in a travel size set because I have been wanting to try out more from this brand. It is silky and smooth, and I love that it is not too thick. I used about 10 drops - which is alot, but I worked it into my skin with a rose quartz roller and it felt so relaxing and made my skin feel fantastic afterwards - soft and supple with no layer of product sitting on top of my face. This face oil is completely unscented, so another plus! (I don't mind my products to have a subtle scent but definitely prefer no scent for skin care!) I am not sure I would buy a full bottle just because there are some similar (or less) priced face oils that I really enjoy and compete with this product. Thats said - I would consider buying the deluxe travel/sample size sets for nights that my skin needs a little more love. Also, at almost $70 for 1 fl. oz. I probably wouldn't use quite as much as 10 drops again! I do recommend it if you're on the market for a new luxury face oil to try out! < 3
